items.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $3.8B in strongest three-week stretch of 2026
items.snippet: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew nearly $1 billion in the latest week as Friday inflows stayed positive despite Bitcoin briefly falling below $79,000.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC за ключовими словами.

items.title: XRP Ledger has fewer active accounts than last year, but bigger trades and more value
items.snippet: Daily order-book traders fell about 40% from a year ago while volume rose 79%, as the value held on XRPL climbed above $4 billion.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо XRP -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Southeast Asia’s crypto funding rebounds to $680 million as investors focus on mature firms
items.snippet: Blockchain investment in Southeast Asia in 2026 has been led by crypto financial services, though funding remains heavily concentrated in Singapore and a handful of companies.
items.note: Позитивний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами.
